head_commit.message:
feat(mcp): give each card a fitting icon

The status card and every settings row reused one generic drawable. Now:

- Status card: the leading icon matches the state (check circle when
  running, hollow circle when stopped, warning when it failed).
- MCP screen: link for Streamable HTTP, sync for HTTP+SSE, power for keep
  alive, wifi for LAN access, terminal for auto-approve, and leading icons
  on the port and token fields.
- Keep-alive screen: power for the switch, bell for notifications, bolt
  for battery optimization, fullscreen for the overlay permission.

All icons are Material icons already used elsewhere in the repo, or
drawables that exist in :core:resources.

head_commit.message:
fix(mcp): stop the keep-alive switch from flipping on its own

applyKeepAlive() wrote the observed value back to DataStore on every
recomposition. Fast toggling started two coroutines whose writes raced, so
a stale write could flip the switch back. The switch already persists its
own value, so applyKeepAlive() now only starts/stops the runtime effect.

feat(mcp): copyable endpoints in a card component

McpEndpointCard wraps each endpoint URL in a tonal card with a copy button
that turns into a check mark for 1.5s. Replaces the plain text rows.
